comment: Easy
If you have other heavy courses, take her fys.
Dr. Brown is nice and means well, but if you want to learn don't take this class. It is an easy A, but I haven't learned a thing

Dr. Brown is one of the sweetest teachers I have had. Her FYS has a reputation for being light and while that is true, you will have to write a few short papers and give a few presentations. Only real downside is that you don't know your standing grade until basically the end of the semester.
Wonderful lady, can't say enough good things. This class is absolute cheese.

Knowing & Choosing is probably the easiest FYS you can take. Dr. Brown is an absolute sweetheart. She's not great with zoom but who can blame her. A lot of the assignments are just for completion, and everyone got a 100 on the midterm. Just use sparknotes for the readings and you'll be absolutely fine. Take this class for an easy A.
Take Prof Brown. Insanely kind and caring. Class is not mandatory and there is hardly any work. Take her class, trust me!
Easy class to pass but beware she has quite an eccentric personality. Be ready to be treated like a kindergartener. Lots of short "papers" and class is based on discussion
Take this class

Seriously.. just take her. Easiest FYS offered plus she's a sweat heart. There are a few short ungraded two page papers in the beginning of the semester, one five page paper (that she lets you redo if you don't get a good grade on), a midterm that most everyone got a 100 on, and two books that you can get away with just spark noting.

Sweetest professor ever. She is very easy so if you don't care about FYS id take her. Its quite a bit of work but her grading is so easy you're nearly guaranteed an A. The general class is thought provoking though so would definitely recommend it.

This class is absurdly easy. The athletes always take it, because they're always told to, and for good reason. Two books that you can easily get by without even buying, anything resembling coherent and somewhat on topic contributions to class and she will like you. If you need a solid A in your FYS (who doesn't want that) , TAKE THIS CLASS!!

Dr. Brown is extremely sweet.  FYS was low workload: we had one essay, a midterm, a digital story, a group project, and two books to read.  All of this work was spread out throughout the semester. Participation is key.

Never read one of the books, still got an A on the midterm and B in the class. She values discussion (which I never participated in). Gives HW (but sparknotes works fine). And, projects are rather easy. Only flaw is that you never know what your final grade is in the class until the end.

Mavis is AMAZING! She inspired me to continue with education. If you put in the effort expected of you, do the work, have a positive attitude, and show you truly care about education, you'll do great. It is a truly rewarding class and I highly recommend you take it with her!
She is a sweet lady.  However, she does not keep you very well updates with your grades and you have no ideas what you have until your final grade is posted.

mavis is such a nice person! everyone loves her-she jut makes core class so enjoyable. we did things like reading dr. suess in the secret garden, playing "the mirror game"...she's very good at leading class discussions too
very nice lady.  not much work during the semester, but ends it with a pretty long final.  overall, it was a fun and pretty slack class

Mavis is the best CORE teacher ever.  If you are assigned her consider yourself graced by God.  She is so nice, easy and enjoyable.  We go outside and draw on dry-erase boards and do all sorts of rad activities.  All you have to say is "I DISAGREE" and youre her new favorite student.  Mavis is sweet so sit back, relax and enjoy.

Mavis is probably one of the easiest/best core profs.  She gives reading reports which are annoying and you have to do them, but theyre easy and basically a joke.  If you put in minimal effort and go to most classes, you will do well

Dr. Brown is the BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!! Our core class is so much fun. She is always finding new and inventive ways to stimulate discussion. If you get her for core, get ready for a fun class, because you got the very best!!
This is the best CORE class in the entire university! If you have her, you should be estatic! Great professor, really really nice! Oh and we did learn stuff too.
Phenomenal.

Maybe we're biased bc our CORE class was the best one on campus, but Mavis really was great. She values your opinions, can crack jokes along with the students, and encourages class unity. CORE definitely wouldn't have been the same (or nearly as enjoyable) without her.
Mavis is so understanding and sincere. She will be like your mother at UR if you need one, and although not totally easy, she's fair. gotta love Mave and core lunches!!!
Mavis is awesome, best teacher I have had at UR so far.

Mavis is the best Core teacher Richmond has.  Our class became really good friends- we even had Core Lunch. Please, be thankful you have Mavis as your professor but do not take advantage of her niceness.  You wouldn't want to ruin a good thing, right?  And she gets a chile pepper in my book.

SCHWEET! What a great professor..if you have her for Core, consider yourself one of the luckiest kids on campus-as Core teachers go, she's pretty easy.  Possibly the nicest lady you'll meet at UR.  Plus, we did cool stuff in her class...like play with clay(yeah, yeah, and we learned stuff too...)
